snippet.title: Tom Felton says he was left fighting back tears as former Harry Potter co-star ... #celebrity
snippet.description:
Tom Felton said he was choking back tears when he noticed his Harry Potter co-star  Warwick Davis at his Broadway performance of Harry Potter and the Cursed Child.

The Draco Malfoy actor, 38, was surprised by the actor who plays Filius Flitwick, 56, at his performance in New York, which has just been extended for two months.

Tom, who has reprised his role as Draco for the stage production, shared a photograph of the pair embracing backstage after Warwick came to watch the show.

He also posted a clip of himself and Warwick at the stage door greeting fans who had waited to meet him after the performance.

Tom also shared a snap from his dressing room, where he took a photo of a Polaroid image of him and Warwick from the same night

He wrote: 'Had a special guest & dear friend come see the show tonight - tbh I nearly cried on stage saying 'Wingardium Leviosa' knowing he was watching - @warwickadavis #swishandflick'.

snippet.title: TOM FELTON vuelve a ser DRACO MALFOY en el ANUNCIO de CUPRA “The Chosen One”
snippet.description:
CUPRA  ha lanzado “The Chosen One”, una campaña global creada junto a &Rosàs
 y protagonizada por Tom Felton. El anuncio reinterpreta la icónica escena de la tienda de varitas de Harry Potter para trasladar la idea de “elección” al mundo de la conducción.

La pieza muestra al actor en un espacio inspirado en Ollivanders, donde distintos volantes compiten hasta que un volante de CUPRA “elige” a su conductor. La campaña busca reforzar la conexión emocional entre coche y conductor, presentando la conducción como una experiencia instintiva y aspiracional.

Además de apoyarse en la nostalgia y en referencias culturales reconocibles a nivel global, la campaña sirve para promocionar tres modelos de la marca: el CUPRA Formentor, el CUPRA Terramar y el CUPRA Leon.

La acción encaja con la estrategia de CUPRA de acercarse al entretenimiento y la cultura pop mediante colaboraciones con figuras reconocidas, como Nathalie Emmanuel, Rosalía o Willow Smith. El objetivo es diferenciar la marca a través de campañas emocionales, creativas y culturalmente relevantes.
